# Best WoW TBC Anniversary addons and how to set them up
## How to get and install WoW TBC Anniversary addons
The easiest way to install addons for WoW TBC Anniversary is to use **[CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/download/app)** . However, when I went to install addons for Classic, there wasn’t a specific “Anniversary Tab” at first.
Ad

Simply updating CurseForge may work as well, or logging in and out of the Anniversary server, but I just dropped an addon in the proper folder, and that was good enough (Image via Blizzard Entertainment || Curseforge) Simply updating CurseForge may work as well, or logging in and out of
the Anniversary server, but I just dropped an addon in the proper folder, and that was good enough (Image via Blizzard Entertainment || Curseforge)
When you open up CurseForge and don’t see a **BCC Anniversary** tab in the app, follow these steps (it’s what I did):
Ad
* Go to your WoW Folder on your PC.
* Go to your Classic or Classic Era folder, and copy/paste one of the addons (Details, or Questie, for example) into your **Anniversary** folder (Anniversary -> Interface -> Addons).
* Reload CurseForge.
